alert.message: Health check found service/container issues: PM2 process 'whisper' is stopped; Docker containers 'langfuse_langfuse-web_1' is restarting, 'lidaros-frontend-1' is unhealthy, and 'omiximo-email-automation' is unhealthy; OpenClaw gateway service status is inconsistent/outdated (systemd runtime inactive while RPC probe still responds).
